title: a live-anchor tooth reads its berth lists from a measured fixture
intention: The live-anchor tooth for 68f563403c8f and c691e19d5464 reads each ticket's decompose writes_to from a measured fixture naming its berth and date, so it measures the anchor on every box, and checks the live berth still equals the fixture wherever the berth exists.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_the_live_anchors_of_68f5_and_c691_are_their_build_parents red '68f563403c8f names no decompose berth' (red at HEAD too); skills.chart.live chain reads all-None for both tickets here, because decompose berths are instance-space on the charting box; the standing seal is green from that box.
traces_to: Law 3 - a measurement recorded in a shape that can be wrong, instead of re-read from a box that may not hold it; Law 5 - the berth is instance-space, so what the class-space proof needs is carried in class-space.
how: A _BERTH_WRITES_TO dict in the proof holds the two lists read with hollow.writes_to on akiendelllinux 2026-11-13 and their berth names; the tooth feeds them to build_anchor; where hollow.writes_to answers it must equal the fixture, and HollowUnmeasurable leaves the fixture standing in.

clauses.claim: on a box without the two berths the tooth is green and anchors 68f563403c8f at edb4e137^ and c691e19d5464 at 448601ca^
where hollow.writes_to answers for a ticket, a live list that differs from the fixture reds the tooth

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow_anchors_before_the_build_that_stands.py, _BERTH_WRITES_TO = {68f563403c8f: berth decompose-20260906T111005-e6c3a299ab9a, writes_to [skills/sail/reflection.py, skills/sail/SKILL.md, cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py, cairn/devices/codemother/ingest.py, cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_feedback_verb.py]; c691e19d5464: berth decompose-20260911T120642-bdf2ac680def, writes_to [ground_loop, cc, operator_inbox, skill_block, skills/ruled intention+why.json, skills/intent/proofs/test_intent_skill.py]}; the tooth uses the fixture, and asserts live == fixture when hollow.writes_to does not raise HollowUnmeasurable.

out: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py (writes_to still derives from the berths)
